behavior: When `KeepAlive` deactivates a trigger, the trigger stops its timers and its safe polygon. A popup that hover opened and that the trigger anchors then closes with the reason `trigger-hover`. This is the exception to the open state that a popup keeps under `KeepAlive`. `KeepAlive` sends no leave event, so the popup would stay open after the activation with no pointer on its trigger. Base UI has no counterpart of `KeepAlive`.
